ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".documents (
        document_version_id  text PRIMARY KEY,            -- '<document_id>:<sha256[:12]>'
        document_id          text NOT NULL,
        project_id           text NOT NULL CHECK (project_id ~ '^P[0-9]{6}$'),
        country_code         text NOT NULL,
        doc_type             text NOT NULL,
        document_role        text,
        title                text NOT NULL,
        document_date        date,
        disclosure_date      date,
        source_url           text NOT NULL,
        sha256               char(64) NOT NULL,
        size_bytes           bigint NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes > 0),
        page_count           integer NOT NULL CHECK (page_count > 0),
        volume_path          text NOT NULL CHECK (volume_path LIKE '/Volumes/%'),
        extraction_version   text NOT NULL,
        pipeline_code_hash   text NOT NULL,
        loaded_at            timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        UNIQUE (document_id, sha256))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".pages (
        document_version_id  text NOT NULL REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".documents (document_version_id),
        page                 integer NOT NULL CHECK (page > 0),
        printed_page_label   text,
        chars                integer,
        tables_detected      integer,
        PRIMARY KEY (document_version_id, page))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".sections (
        section_id           text PRIMARY KEY,
        document_version_id  text NOT NULL REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".documents (document_version_id),
        section_path         text NOT NULL,
        heading_text         text,
        heading_level        integer,
        section_order        integer,
        page_start           integer,
        page_end             integer,
        printed_page_label_start text,
        printed_page_label_end   text)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".parent_chunks (
        parent_id            text PRIMARY KEY,
        document_version_id  text NOT NULL REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".documents (document_version_id),
        section_path         text,
        page_start           integer NOT NULL,
        page_end             integer NOT NULL,
        text                 text NOT NULL,
        child_ids            text[] NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".retrieval_units (
        unit_id              text PRIMARY KEY,
        document_version_id  text NOT NULL REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".documents (document_version_id),
        unit_type            text NOT NULL CHECK (unit_type IN ('chunk', 'table')),
        strategy_version     text NOT NULL,
        section_id           text,
        section_path         text,
        parent_id            text REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".parent_chunks (parent_id),
        table_id             text,
        page_start           integer NOT NULL,
        page_end             integer NOT NULL CHECK (page_end >= page_start),
        printed_page_label   text,
        indexed_text         text NOT NULL,              -- exactly the text that was embedded
        excerpt              text NOT NULL,              -- sanitised text shown to users
        indexed_text_sha256  char(64) NOT NULL,
        source_spans         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,   -- paragraph/page spans the unit was built from
        sanitisation         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".unit_embeddings (
        unit_id              text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".retrieval_units (unit_id),
        model                text NOT NULL,
        preprocessing        jsonb NOT NULL,             -- e.g. {"normalize_embeddings": true, "input": "indexed_text"}
        source_cache         text NOT NULL,              -- cached .npy file the vector was read from
        embedding            vector(768) NOT NULL,
        embedding_sha256     char(64) NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "unit_embeddings_hnsw_cosine" ON "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".unit_embeddings USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".citations (
        unit_id              text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".retrieval_units (unit_id),
        document_version_id  text NOT NULL REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".documents (document_version_id),
        project_id           text NOT NULL,
        document_id          text NOT NULL,
        page_start           integer NOT NULL,
        page_end             integer NOT NULL,
        printed_page_label   text,
        section_path         text,
        source_url           text NOT NULL,
        volume_path          text NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".table_schemas (
        table_schema_id      text PRIMARY KEY,            -- e.g. 'wb_isr_results_indicators_v1'
        description          text NOT NULL,
        fields               jsonb NOT NULL,              -- [{"name", "type", "unit_source"}, ...]
        status               text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'approved', 'retired')))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".pdf_tables (
        table_id             text PRIMARY KEY,
        document_version_id  text NOT NULL REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".documents (document_version_id),
        table_group_id       text NOT NULL,               -- logical table spanning continuation parts
        table_schema_id      text REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".table_schemas (table_schema_id),
        page                 integer NOT NULL,
        caption              text,
        section_path         text,
        header               jsonb NOT NULL,
        n_columns            integer NOT NULL,
        n_data_rows          integer NOT NULL,
        continuation_of      text,
        description          text,                        -- searchable description of the logical table
        extraction_version   text NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".pdf_table_rows (
        table_id             text NOT NULL REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".pdf_tables (table_id),
        row_index            integer NOT NULL,
        page                 integer NOT NULL,
        is_header            boolean NOT NULL,
        cells                jsonb NOT NULL,              -- sanitised cells, original column order
        PRIMARY KEY (table_id, row_index))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".pdf_table_values (
        table_id             text NOT NULL,
        row_index            integer NOT NULL,
        field_name           text NOT NULL,
        value_text           text,
        value_numeric        numeric,
        unit                 text,
        quality              text NOT NULL CHECK (quality IN ('complete_row', 'needs_review')),
        PRIMARY KEY (table_id, row_index, field_name),
        FOREIGN KEY (table_id, row_index) REFERENCES "wbg_rag_pdf_poc".pdf_table_rows (table_id, row_index))
